plugin.name: Threat Intel
plugin.description: Look up IPs, domains, URLs and file hashes in VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, GreyNoise, urlscan.io, Shodan, AlienVault OTX and MISP, or enrich them all at once with IOC Enrich.
plugin.author: Landflow

nodes.name: virusTotal
nodes.description: Look up an IP address, domain, URL or file hash in VirusTotal
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}

options.name: Get
options.description: Get the reputation of this indicator

options.name: Get
options.description: Get the reputation of this indicator

options.name: Get
options.description: Get the reputation of this indicator

options.name: Get
options.description: Get the reputation of this indicator

properties.name: ip
properties.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address

properties.name: domain
properties.description: Domain name

properties.name: url
properties.description: The full URL; it is encoded as VirusTotal's URL identifier (base64url without padding)

properties.name: hash
properties.description: MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256

properties.name: simple
properties.description: Whether to return {malicious, suspicious, harmless, undetected, reputation, lastAnalysisDate, link} instead of the full report

nodes.toolDescription: Look up an indicator in VirusTotal (read only). resource=ip needs ip, domain needs domain, url needs url and file needs hash (MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256); operation=get. Returns how many engines flag it (malicious, suspicious, harmless, undetected), its reputation and a link; simple=false returns the full report.

nodes.name: abuseIpDb
nodes.description: Check an IP address against AbuseIPDB's abuse reports
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}

options.name: Check
options.description: Check the abuse reports of an IP address

properties.name: ip
properties.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address

properties.name: maxAgeInDays
properties.description: Only reports newer than this count (1-365)

properties.name: verbose
properties.description: Whether to include the individual reports (reportedAt, comment, categories…)

nodes.toolDescription: Check an IP address in AbuseIPDB (read only): resource=ip, operation=check, ip, optional maxAgeInDays (1-365, default 30) and verbose (adds the report list). Returns abuseConfidenceScore (0-100), totalReports, country, ISP and usage type.

nodes.name: greyNoise
nodes.description: Look up an IP address in GreyNoise's Community API: is it internet background noise or a known benign service?
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}

options.name: Get
options.description: Look up an IP address in the Community API

properties.name: ip
properties.description: IPv4 address

nodes.toolDescription: Look up an IP address in GreyNoise Community (read only): resource=ip, operation=get, ip. Returns noise (it scans the internet), riot (a known benign service), classification (benign, malicious or unknown), name and last_seen. seen=false means GreyNoise has never observed the IP, which is a normal answer.

nodes.name: urlscan
nodes.description: Search urlscan.io's existing scans and read a scan result
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}

options.name: Get Result
options.description: Get the result of a scan by its UUID

properties.name: query
properties.description: urlscan.io search query

properties.name: size
properties.description: Max number of results to return

properties.name: uuid
properties.description: The scan's UUID

properties.name: simple
properties.description: Whether to return a compact summary instead of urlscan.io's full JSON

nodes.toolDescription: Read urlscan.io scans (read only, never submits a scan). resource=scan; operation=search needs query (urlscan search syntax, for example domain:example.com or ip:"1.2.3.4") and optional size; operation=getResult needs uuid and returns the page, verdicts (score, malicious, categories) and a link.

nodes.name: shodan
nodes.description: Look up what Shodan knows about an IP address, or resolve hostnames
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}

options.name: Get
options.description: Get the information Shodan has about an IP address

properties.name: ip
properties.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address

properties.name: simple
properties.description: Whether to return {ip, found, hostnames, domains, org, isp, country, os, ports, vulns, tags, lastUpdate, link} instead of Shodan's full banner data

properties.name: hostnames
properties.description: Comma-separated hostnames

nodes.toolDescription: Query Shodan (read only). resource=host, operation=get, ip: open ports, services, vulnerabilities, hostnames, organisation and tags for the IP (found=false when Shodan has no data). resource=dns, operation=lookup, hostnames (comma-separated): the IP address of each hostname.

nodes.name: alienVaultOtx
nodes.description: Look up an indicator in AlienVault OTX and see the threat pulses that mention it
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}

options.name: Get
options.description: Get the general section of an indicator

properties.name: indicator
properties.description: The IP address, domain, hostname, URL or file hash (MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256)

properties.name: simple
properties.description: Whether to return {indicator, type, found, pulseCount, pulses, reputation, country, asn, link} instead of OTX's full general section

nodes.toolDescription: Look up an indicator in AlienVault OTX (read only): resource=indicator, operation=get, indicatorType (IPv4, IPv6, domain, hostname, url or file) and indicator. Returns the pulse count and names, reputation, country and ASN for the general section; found=false when OTX has no record.

nodes.name: misp
nodes.description: Search the attributes of your own MISP instance for an indicator
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}

properties.name: value
properties.description: The indicator to find, such as an IP, domain, URL or hash

properties.name: type
properties.description: An attribute type, or several separated by commas

properties.name: tags
properties.description: Only attributes with these tags, separated by commas

properties.name: last
properties.description: Only attributes newer than this age

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Max number of attributes to return

properties.name: simple
properties.description: Whether to return compact attributes ({id, eventId, type, category, value, toIds, timestamp, comment, tags, eventInfo, link}) instead of MISP's full JSON

nodes.toolDescription: Search a MISP instance's attributes (read only): resource=attribute, operation=search, with at least one of value (an IP, domain, URL or hash; use % as a wildcard), type (for example ip-dst, domain, md5), tags (comma-separated), last (age, for example 7d or 12h), and optional limit. Returns the matching attributes with their event and tags.

nodes.name: iocEnrich
nodes.description: Enrich IPs, domains, URLs and file hashes with every threat-intel service you attach, and get one verdict
nodes.subtitle: threat intel verdict

properties.name: iocPath
properties.description: Dot path to the item's IOC: an object {type, value} or a plain string. Used when the item has no IOCs array.

properties.name: typePath
properties.description: Dot path to the IOC type (ip, domain, url or hash; empty or auto detects it). Used when the item has no IOC object.

properties.name: valuePath
properties.description: Dot path to the IOC value. Used when the item has no IOC object.

properties.name: iocsPath
properties.description: Dot path to an array of IOCs ({type, value} objects or plain strings). When the item has one, it wins over the single IOC fields.

properties.name: services
properties.description: Which services may be asked. A service also needs its credential attached to this node (GreyNoise's key is optional but the credential is not).

properties.name: cacheTtl
properties.description: How long a service's answer is reused for the same IOC, so a burst of alerts does not spend the API quota. 0 turns the cache off. The cache lives in the plugin process; failed lookups are never cached.

values.name: enrichAll
values.description: When the item has an IOCs array, enrich every element (off: only the first)

values.name: concurrency
values.description: How many service calls run at once (1-10)

values.name: maliciousThreshold
values.description: The overall verdict is malicious when the highest service score reaches this (or a service says malicious)

values.name: suspiciousThreshold
values.description: The overall verdict is suspicious when the highest service score reaches this

values.name: outputField
values.description: The item field that receives the result

values.name: keepInput
values.description: Whether the output item keeps the input item's fields next to the result

nodes.toolDescription: Enrich indicators of compromise with threat intelligence (read only). Give value (and type: ip, domain, url or hash; detected when omitted) or an iocs array of {type, value}. Asks every configured service that supports the type and returns threatIntel: verdict (malicious, suspicious, clean or unknown), score (0-100 or null), reasons and one result per service. Private, reserved and loopback IPs are skipped.

type.description: What value is; detected when omitted

value.description: The IP address, domain, URL or file hash (defanged forms such as hxxp://evil[.]com are accepted)

properties.name: apiKey

properties.name: baseUrl

properties.name: baseUrl
